items.text: Borrow the airport's three differently oriented runways as a design for three voluntary pedestrian exit paths on willing property owners' existing land. The association pays a site designer to lay out three directional paths from the recreation-center exit, so departing groups can spread their conversations across routes instead of collecting at one chokepoint; no parking or business hours change. Use aggregated 311 complaints and anonymous voluntary feedback at days 30 and 90. The association pays the design and signage costs and handles consultation within its volunteer budget; teenagers and employees do not staff the routes.

Borrow the airport's published division of operations into general aviation, air taxi and military categories, rather than its particular percentages. The association pays an analyst to divide existing 311 complaints into coarse activity categories without publishing homes, identities or complaint locations, then reserves separate portions of its remaining mitigation funds in proportion to those aggregate activity shares instead of allowing the loudest public meeting faction to capture the whole budget. It publishes only category totals and funded interventions; it collects no new surveillance. Compare category-level complaints after 90 days. The association bears the analytical cost.

Borrow the airport unit's documented changes of mission while keeping an organizational home. The association designates one paid coordinator for the 90-day trial but makes that coordinator's mission change at days 30 and 60 if aggregate complaints have not improved: first adjust association-funded acoustic measures, then redesign voluntary departure information, then offer different association-funded garage treatments. The job, remaining budget and eight-hour monthly volunteer ceiling stay fixed while the funded task changes; residents need no permission to continue their activities. Compare existing 311 totals and voluntary anonymous feedback at each review. The association bears the coordinator cost.

Call the restaurant's voluntary quiet-close routine Juniper Airport. The restaurant owner lowers patio music at 11pm while keeping the midnight closing time. Compare aggregate 311 complaints before and after 90 days; the owner bears the adjustment. Use the airport name on the printed reminder.
